newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's RoloBanca '96 gross op profit up.
newsitem.headline: Italy's RoloBanca '96 gross op profit up.

text.p: Italian bank Rolo Banca said it expected its gross operating profit for 1996 to be 11 percent up on 1995 at 960 billion lire.
Rolo Banca said in a statement that according to provisional figures its net profit was expected to be more than 400 billion lire in 1996.
In 1995 Rolo Banca Spa had a net profit of 193 billion lire, which it said was not comparable with the 1996 figure because the bank had incorporated three companies.
Rolo said total deposits stood at 106.2 trillion lire, up 12 percent on the previous year, while loans totalled 31.0 trillion, up 17.8 percent.
Rolo said all 1996 figures were for Rolo Banca Spa.
